part.text: The spec and tests are clear. I'll implement `Garden` with validation in `NewGarden` and a name→plants map built from the alphabetically sorted (copied) children.

All tests pass. Implementation in `kindergarten_garden.go`:

- **`Garden`** holds the two diagram rows and a map from child name to their four plant names.
- **`NewGarden`** validates the input, returning errors for: missing leading newline, not exactly two rows, mismatched row lengths, an odd number of cups, invalid cup codes (anything other than `G`, `C`, `R`, `V`), and duplicate child names. It then sorts a **copy** of the children slice (so the caller's slice is never modified, as `TestNamesNotModified` requires) and assigns each child their two cups per row, left to right.
- **`Plants`** does a map lookup, returning the four plant names in row-major order (first row left/right, then second row left/right) and whether the child was found.

`go test ./...` reports `ok kindergarten` — no changes to the test file and no new files.
